faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How does the B2B subscription work?
faq.a1: You choose a package, pay monthly or yearly via Stripe, and your company instantly gets access to the management portal.
faq.a2: After a successful payment your company account is created or activated automatically and the owner role is assigned.
faq.a3: Yes. The B2C app is completely free for private customers who want to rent a vehicle.
faq.a4: All payments are processed by Stripe with bank-grade encryption. We never store your card details.
faq.q5: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept major credit and debit cards through Stripe Checkout.
faq.a6: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your portal. Access stays active until the end of the paid period.
faq.a7: Yes, our professional support team is available for all subscribed companies.
faq.a8: Data security is our priority. All data is encrypted and stored securely and compliantly.
